mateo: Heads up — nightly evals show a spike in top-k low-prob outputs for grove-7b-q6f after today's runtime rollout. Repro steps attached. @chen @olivia :eyes:
chen: saw that in dashboards, failure rate up ~2.8% on conversation prompt set, not just one seed.
olivia: is this the attention reorder kernel we rolled at 03:10 UTC? Iirc that touched prefetch ordering.
jamie: deploy-bot: rolled runtime/attn-prefetch v2 -> service-group-prod at 2026-03-18T03:10Z
mateo: repro command:
```
python tests/repro/run_eval.py --model grove-7b-q6f-quant --seed 42 --batch 1 --kernel attn_prefetch_v2
```
mateo: sample output differences: expected 'I recommend...' -> got 'I recommendn't...' (lol)
olivia: can you paste a minimal pair with logprobs? also check rng seeding path
mateo: pasted pair + topk probs:
```
EXPECTED: I recommend exploring the feature further.
LOGP: -12.3
ACTUAL: I recommend exploringn't the feature.
LOGP: -9.1
```
chen: that looks like sampling bias toward shorter/unnatural tokens — suggests temperature or softmax numerics
jamie: quick idea: compare fused-softmax path vs fallback. run with ENV OVERRIDE:
```
export RUNTIME_SOFTMAX=scalar_fallback
./bin/serve_local --kernel attn_prefetch_v2
```
mateo: ran fallback, failure rate dropped back to baseline in 50 samples. :white_check_mark:
olivia: ok that isolates to the optimized softmax / kernel fusion with prefetch ordering. filing a bug.
mateo: filing: https://phab/review/T12345
eval-bot: nightly-eval: grove-7b-q6f-quant conversation-prompts failure_rate 5.9% -> alert triggered
chen: flags: revert? or hotfix to force fallback on that kernel for q6f models
olivia: prefer targeted rollback of attn_prefetch_v2 for quant models until patch
jamie: scheduling rollback window in 20m. I'll coordinate with infra. :ambulance:
mateo: thanks — will run expanded repro and collect regression diffs
olivia: thumbs — keep notes in thread
